case: list_audit reads the calling tenant's events through AuditQueryPort up to a cutoff sequence and returns the chain verification result and the cutoff
list_audit appends exactly one access event after fixing its cutoff; the event is absent from its own result, returning it creates no further event, and the next call shows it
With the audit sink down list_audit returns AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE and no events
AuditQueryPort is tenant-scoped: another tenant's events are invisible and the chains are separate
A tampered chain is reported by the verification result and the events are neither trimmed nor repaired
For each of OP-01..OP-12 with the audit sink down the result is AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, with no result and no state change
For each state-changing operation the audit event is appended before the commit; a failing append leaves every store untouched
A store failure after the audit append returns STORE_UNAVAILABLE, no result, one attempted FAILED event and no record of a completed change
A missing, forged or expired context produces the context error and no tenant audit event, on every operation
Audit events hold identifiers and digests only: a planted licensed value never appears in any event
Inventory: for every operation the error list in the register equals the common failures plus its specific ones, and each listed code is reachable by a case
A refusal (for example INTENTION_NOT_ALLOWED) produces an event with outcome REFUSED and the error code
AuditQueryPort contract: tenant-scoped read with from_seq and limit, verify, copies returned, no write path
In SIGNAL_RULES a market-signal rule with basis OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_ONLY is refused for each outcome: ACT_NOW, WAIT, STAGE, NEGOTIATE (BUY) and ACT_NOW, HOLD, WAIT (SELL)
An OWNER_ASSUMPTION rule missing its owner reference or its assumption statement is refused

A rule placed after a signal-influenced rule (a downstream rule) is refused unless it is OWNER_ASSUMPTION with owner reference and assumption statement, whatever the configured outcome of the earlier signal-influenced rule (NOT_ASSESSED included) and whatever the downstream rule's own configured outcome (NOT_ASSESSED included)
A rule that uses only data-quality or gap predicates is not treated as signal-influenced and needs no assumption basis
A pack containing OWNER_ASSUMPTION rules activates only with a verified approval reference, and results record that reference
A unit without value_domain is refused as PACK_MALFORMED; a conversion series outside the POSITIVE domain is refused
A movement threshold of zero, below zero or not an exact integer ratio is refused
Each of ACT_NOW, WAIT, STAGE, NEGOTIATE (BUY) and ACT_NOW, HOLD, WAIT (SELL) fired by a market-signal rule carries the assumption label with owner reference and statement
The signal-influence class is DIRECT, PRECEDENCE or NONE by the one definition of MIE-R-63 (fired rule signal-influenced; fired rule downstream; neither) and is disclosed on every result
An outcome fixed by a rule placed before any signal-influenced rule has class NONE and no assumption label
Under CONTEXT_ONLY signals appear as context beside the outcome and the class is NONE for every outcome
A signal-influenced outcome with stale, expired, unavailable or conflicting evidence is qualified and is never presented as a forecast or a tendency of prices
RELATIVE movement with a zero start gives NOT_ASSESSED ZERO_BASE and a listed gap for every end value, positive, negative and zero
RELATIVE movement with a negative start is direction-safe: -10 to -5 is UP with ratio 1/2 and -10 to -15 is DOWN with ratio -1/2
A movement between values of opposite sign states crosses_zero true: -10 to 10 is UP with ratio 2 and 10 to -10 is DOWN with ratio -2
ABSOLUTE movement is defined for zero and negative starts: 0 to 5 UP, -5 to 0 UP, 5 to 0 DOWN, with the boundary exactly at T
Negating every value of a SIGNED series negates the difference and the ratio and exchanges UP with DOWN under both bases (property test)
A value outside the unit's declared domain is rejected with VALUE_OUT_OF_DOMAIN: POSITIVE rejects zero and negatives, NON_NEGATIVE rejects negatives, SIGNED accepts both
A missing movement_basis or threshold gives NOT_ASSESSED PARAMETER_MISSING and the core assumes no basis
Values with different decimal exponents align exactly to a common exponent; no float is created; the ratios are identical to those of the same values at one exponent
The core has no call to ObservationSourcePort or to any feed on any path (static call and import scan; a planted call is detected)
submit_observations re-validates every item: an invalid item that an adapter marks as pre-validated is rejected with the field named

Resubmitting the same batch (a driver retry) yields duplicates and no second observation
A feed failure (unavailable, malformed, empty) is adapter-side: no core operation is invoked, no core state changes, and no feed error code exists in the core vocabulary
A partial feed leaves missing days; get_signals and assess_timing list them as gaps and fill nothing
get_signals and assess_timing perform no retrieval: a double that fails on any feed call is never called

case: Exact sequence of the finding: rule 1 signal-influenced (OWNER_ASSUMPTION) with configured outcome NOT_ASSESSED; rule 2 OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_ONLY with outcome ACT_NOW; validate_pack and register_pack refuse the pack with PACK_RULE_POLICY_VIOLATION and nothing is stored
The same sequence is refused for each later outcome: ACT_NOW, WAIT, STAGE, NEGOTIATE (BUY) and ACT_NOW, HOLD, WAIT (SELL)

A downstream rule whose own configured outcome is NOT_ASSESSED and whose basis is OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_ONLY is refused too; there is no NOT_ASSESSED exemption, before or after the earlier signal-influenced rule's own outcome
A refused pack produces no result of any class: register_pack stores nothing, get_pack and activate_pack return NOT_FOUND, and assess_timing against its pin returns PACK_NOT_ACTIVE
A downstream OWNER_ASSUMPTION rule that lacks its owner reference, or lacks its assumption statement, is refused

The valid owner-labelled version (signal-influenced NOT_ASSESSED rule, then an OWNER_ASSUMPTION rule with owner reference and assumption statement) is accepted by validate_pack and register_pack; a rule placed before the first signal-influenced rule may still be OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_ONLY

In the valid owner-labelled pack, when the signal-influenced NOT_ASSESSED rule does not match and the later ACT_NOW rule fires, the class is PRECEDENCE, the outcome carries the assumption label with the fired rule's owner reference and assumption statement, and the earlier signal-influenced rule is listed as evaluated

Class matrix on one pack: a firing signal-influenced rule gives DIRECT; a firing downstream rule gives PRECEDENCE; a firing rule placed before the first signal-influenced rule gives NONE; a firing rule that is both signal-influenced and downstream gives DIRECT
NO_TABLE and NO_RULE_MATCHED give NOT_ASSESSED with class NONE and no assumption label; with NO_RULE_MATCHED the identifiers of the signal-influenced rules evaluated are listed
A firing downstream rule whose configured outcome is NOT_ASSESSED (owner-labelled) has class PRECEDENCE and carries the assumption label, as an actionable one does

Fail closed: a test double gives the evaluator a fired DIRECT or PRECEDENCE rule that lacks the owner basis, owner reference or assumption statement; the result is INTERNAL_ERROR_FAIL_CLOSED, a FAILED audit event is appended, no outcome is emitted and no result is stored

Reordering: a pack version that moves an unlabelled rule from before to after a signal-influenced rule is refused (the check uses the submitted order, not a sorted or stored order); with the unlabelled rule first it is accepted
